title: Grounds Keeper
description: Black Hills State University is hiring a full-time Grounds Keeper to maintain the beauty and functionality of our Rapid City campus. This position plays a vital role in supporting a safe, sustainable, and inviting environment for students, faculty, staff, and visitors. DUTIES: Maintain lawns, nurseries, trees, flowers, shrubs, and irrigation systems. Care for streets, sidewalks, and related equipment. Remove snow during winter months. Load, unload, and move furniture, equipment, materials, and supplies. KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES: Strong knowledge of gardening and grounds maintenance practices.  Ability to recognize and address plant diseases and insect damage.  Capability to work outdoors in all weather conditions.  Proficiency in following oral and written instructions.  Physical ability to perform heavy lifting and manual labor. Experience operating motorized vehicles, tools, and equipment. Professional interaction with co-workers and patrons.  Reliable and consistent attendance. REQUIREMENTS:  Previous and demonstrated landscaping or groundskeeping experience.  Occasional travel to the Spearfish campus.  Ability to obtain a pesticide applicator license within the first 12-months of employment.  TO APPLY: Applications for this position must be made online at http://yourfuture.sdbor.edu. Applicants must complete the online application and also attach a cover letter, resume and the names and contact information for three professional references. This position is open until filled with a first review date of August 19, 2026 at 11PM MDT. For application assistance, contact Human Resources at 605.642.6549. Questions specific to the position can be directed to Rhyse Naylor at 605.642.6147. Arrangements for accommodations required by disabilities can be made by contacting Cassie Maser at 605-642-6545 or Cassie.Maser@bhsu.edu . Employment is dependent upon a satisfactory background check.

title: Admissions Operations & Visit Coordinator
description: The Office of Admissions at Black Hills State University is seeking service-oriented, highly organized, and detail-focused internal university candidates for the position of Admissions Operations & Visit Coordinator . This position serves as a key operational team member within the Office of Admissions, providing critical administrative, technical, and visitor experience support that directly contributes to student recruitment and enrollment. Reporting to the Director of Admissions, this position plays an essential role in ensuring efficient admissions operations, accurate student record management, compliance with institutional and Board of Regents policies, and the coordination of prospective student campus visits and recruitment events. The successful candidate will work closely with students, families, faculty, staff, and university leadership while serving as a primary resource for admissions processes and enrollment-related services. DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES This position provides operational coordination and administrative support for many of the day-to-day functions of the Office of Admissions and will work collaboratively with all members of the Admissions staff. Responsibilities include front-line customer service (inbound phone lines, departmental email inbox, physical mail management, in-person visitor traffic, etc.), admissions application and document processing, student records management, database and system maintenance, staff support, campus visit coordination, event planning, budget and purchasing support, and implementation of admissions-related policies and procedures. This position serves as the primary coordinator for prospective student campus visits and recruitment events, ensuring a welcoming and seamless experience for visitors. The Admissions Operations & Visit Coordinator also supervises and coordinates Admissions student employees, including campus tour guides and office assistants. Additional responsibilities include monitoring compliance requirements, preparing reports, managing departmental purchasing and travel processes, coordinating office workflows, assisting with policy interpretation and implementation, and collaborating with campus partners to support enrollment goals and student recruitment initiatives. KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, & ABILITIES Prior work experience in BHSU student services, admissions, administrative operations, customer service, or other related university department(s). Knowledge of BHSU operations, departments, policies, and processes. Prior experience using Banner, SDezBuy, and other university technology platforms. Experience with Microsoft Office applications. Supervisory, event planning, budget processing, or student employee management experience preferred. Demonstrated ability to provide exceptional customer service and work effectively with a variety of constituents. Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. High level of attention to detail, accuracy, and confidentiality. Ability to interpret and apply policies and procedures.   TO APPLY: Applications must be made online at https://yourfuture.sdbor.edu . Please attach a cover letter, resume, and names/contact information of at least three professional references. This position is open until filled with a first review date of August 6, 2026 at 11PM MDT. For application assistance, contact Human Resources at 605.642.6549. Questions specific to the position may be directed to Joe Rainboth at Joe.Rainboth@bhsu.edu . Arrangements for accommodations required by disabilities can be made by contacting Cassie Maser at 605-642-6545 or Cassie.Maser@bhsu.edu . Employment is dependent upon a satisfactory background check.

title: Student Services Coordinator
description: Black Hills State University is seeking applicants to fill a Student Services Coordinator. General Summary: Black Hills State University (BHSU) seeks a dynamic, student-focused professional to serve as the Student Services Coordinator at the BHSU–Rapid City campus. Reporting to the Vice President for Continuing Education & Workforce Development, this position serves as the primary front-facing representative of the university and plays a central role in recruitment, admissions, and enrollment services. The coordinator leads the student journey from initial inquiry through registration and transition to academic advising, ensuring a seamless and student-centered experience. This role is responsible for developing and executing strategic recruitment and outreach initiatives to support a broad range of student populations, including first-time/full-time students, adult learners, transfer students, and military-affiliated students (active duty, guardsmen, and veterans). The Student Services Coordinator also serves as the primary coordinator for BHSU–Rapid City events, leading the planning and execution of campus visits, preview days, recruitment events, and New Student Registration experiences. This position requires a highly motivated, self-directed professional who exercises independent judgment, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and is passionate about helping students succeed. title: Assistant Director, Facilities Planning and Management
description: Black Hills State University invites qualified, self-motivated candidates to apply for the position of Assistant Director, Facilities Planning and Management within the Facilities Services Department. The Assistant Director of Facilities Planning and Management provides leadership and oversight for campus facilities operations, maintenance, planning, sustainability, and capital projects. This position supports the Associate Vice President for Facilities Services in ensuring that university facilities are safe, efficient, sustainable, and aligned with institutional priorities. The Assistant Director plays a key role in strategic planning, project management, budgeting, and supervision of facilities staff. DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: ·Assist in the planning, coordination, and implementation of new construction, renovation, and maintenance projects. ·Provide direct supervision and leadership to a team of 28 custodians, ensuring efficient and effective cleaning operations across campus facilities. ·Support daily operations of Facilities Services, including building maintenance and grounds operations. ·Oversee project budgets, schedules, and contractor performance to ensure compliance with university standards, codes, and regulations. ·Develop and monitor preventive maintenance programs and operational procedures to maximize efficiency and extend facility life cycles. ·Collaborate with campus departments and external partners to support space planning, sustainability, and accessibility initiatives. ·Supervise and mentor assigned staff, fostering a culture of safety, accountability, and professional growth. ·Assist in long-range facilities planning, including capital improvement projects and deferred maintenance strategies. ·Ensure compliance with state and federal regulations, building codes, and institutional policies. Manage space utilization and reporting, maintaining accurate building data and preparing required Board of Regents reports. ·Lead sustainability programming and events such as Earth Day, Tree Campus USA, and Go Green Pledge Month. ·Submit daily NOAA weather data and oversee campus alerts through the Everbridge notification system. ·Support emergency planning, preparedness, and continuity operations for the university. ·Assist with annual budget development and monitor departmental budgets to ensure efficient use of resources. ·Demonstrated experience supervising staff and managing budgets. ·Strong organizational, communication, and leadership skills. ·Knowledge of facilities planning, safety practices, and sustainability principles in a higher education or similar environment. ·Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities effectively. QUALIFICATIONS: Required:  ·Bachelor’s degree in a related field. ·Valid driver’s license and ability to travel as required.  Preferred: -Master’s degree in a related field. -Three years of progressively responsible experience in facilities operations, construction management, or related areas.  ·Experience in higher education or government facilities management.  ·Familiarity with project management software and facilities management systems.  COMMENTS: ·This position reports to the Associate Vice President for Facilities Services. Typical work hours are Monday through Friday, 7:30am to 4:30pm, with occasional irregular hours, travel, or weekend work as needed. ·Sponsorship is not available for this position. TO APPLY: Applications must be submitted online at https://yourfuture.sdbor.edu. Candidates must attach a cover letter, resume, and contact information for at least three professional references. title: Assistant Professor, Biology (Organismal Zoology)
description: The School of Natural Sciences at Black Hills State University invites applicants for a full-time, tenure-track, Assistant Professor position in organismal zoology, beginning August 2026. The successful candidate will join a diverse Natural Science department and complement other faculty in areas of ecology, evolution, physiology, genetics and cell-molecular biology. DUTIES: The successful candidate will help shape and grow the new wildlife emphasis within the Biology major by teaching upper-level courses that support wildlife students (ecology, mammalogy, herpetology, ichthyology, environmental policy, etc), as well as introductory courses in Biology as needed. We seek a broadly trained wildlife biologist or ecologist who will complement existing faculty strengths in the School of Natural Sciences and develop collaborations with local and regional agencies. Individuals with expertise in wildlife or fisheries management are especially encouraged to apply. Primary responsibilities include successful teaching and advising, development of a research program that includes undergraduate and graduate students, and service related to student professional opportunities. Other opportunities include supervision of graduate students in the Integrative Genomics MSc. program, and course instruction in the Sustainability MSc. program. QUALIFICATIONS: A PhD in Biology, Wildlife Ecology, Natural Resources or related field. ABD accepted. COMMENTS: The School of Natural Sciences at Black Hills State University is a vibrant, growing division with approximately 23 faculty members in biology, chemistry, geology, and physics. Faculty emphasize undergraduate teaching and mentoring, and conduct research involving students in multiple biological and environmental disciplines. Projects are funded through a variety of state wildlife, federal agency, and partnership grants. Research resources include the largest Herbarium in the state, and well-equipped laboratories including a scanning electron microscopy lab. The Center for the Conservation of Biological Resources (CCBR) is a shared research laboratory containing research space and commonly used equipment required for genetics and genomics research. WestCore is a Genetics/Genomics sequencing core facility that provides services including NextGen genome, transcriptome, and Sanger sequencing, genotyping, and quantitative real-time PCR services. WestCore also houses a cell culture area and an RNA isolation room. The Black Hills State University Underground Campus (BHUC) at the Sanford Underground Research Facility (SURF) in Lead, SD houses Sanford Lab’s low background counting facility, a class-1,000 cleanroom, and an adjoining workspace available for use in a variety of disciplines. Managed by BHSU, the underground campus partners with groups around the globe to create unique opportunities for collaborative research in physics, chemistry, biology, and geophysics. SPECIAL COMMENTS: The successful applicant must be authorized to work in the United States. Sponsorship is not available for this position. TO APPLY: Applications must be made online at http://yourfuture.sdbor.edu. Please submit a cover letter, curriculum vitae, a statement of teaching philosophy, statement of proposed research, transcripts, and names and contact information for at least three professional references. Letters of reference/recommendation are not accepted. (Please note, you may need to combine documents into one file to upload into the system.) This position is open until filled with a first review date of June 19, 2026 at 11:00 PM (mountain time). For application assistance, contact Human Resources at 605.642.6549. Please direct inquiries regarding the position to Dr. Jessica Graham, search committee chair, at Jessica.Graham@bhsu.edu.
